nightcap_dungeon_spawns.create:
CREATE TABLE `nightcap_dungeon_spawns` (
  `zone_id` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `spawn_id` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `npc_id` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `group_id` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `boss_id` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `is_final` tinyint(3) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `x` float NOT NULL,
  `y` float NOT NULL,
  `z` float NOT NULL,
  `heading` float NOT NULL,
  `respawn` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `grid_id` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY (`zone_id`,`spawn_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `CONSTRAINT_1` CHECK (`is_final` in (0,1))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE `grid` (
  `id` int(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `zoneid` int(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `type` int(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `type2` int(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY (`zoneid`,`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=latin1

CREATE TABLE `grid_entries` (
  `gridid` int(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `zoneid` int(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `number` int(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `x` float NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `y` float NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `z` float NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

  `pause` int(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

  PRIMARY KEY (`zoneid`,`gridid`,`number`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=latin1
